title: 第226章 月华剑第225章 老秃驴当真贼子也
slug: 每日情报从打渔人开始武道通神
lines: 【注：燕国降龙寺住持方丈‘守卑’，早年以命妙法『心陀敕』算出『钓海福地』！】
【推演显化，福地衍生命数子‘萧武’天性豪迈豁达、刚烈果决，命格与心性皆与降龙寺释法暗合。】
【守卑遂以命妙法操控降龙寺下庙‘罪僧血头陀’远赴齐国，潜伏于云水湖沉剑坞，以沾染命数！】
【今时，他在以命妙法遮掩天机，密令‘守冲’南下赴齐，名义是捉拿‘罪僧血头陀’，实则是想伺机渡化萧武，欲将其诱拐归燕，削发修释！】
血头陀！
沈修寒瞳孔紧缩，心中翻起滔天骇浪，满眼皆是不可置信：
‘那沉剑坞二当家，竟是燕国降龙寺多年前布下的落子…’
‘他们早早算出了『钓海福地』的开启之日，特地将人送到云水湖周围蛰伏…’
‘可问题是，他们凭什么笃定血头陀一定能沾染上命数？’
沈修寒眉头紧皱，苦苦思索，蓦然间一道亮光充斥在脑海，让他瞳孔瞬间长大：
‘想起来了！’
‘那夜，段枭在长云县与师父相搏之时，曾使出过一门罕见的释道武技…’
‘那门拳法…似乎是唤作『千手降龙拳』？！’
‘千手降龙拳…降龙寺…’
沈修寒心脏狂跳，恍然大悟暗道：
‘大齐境内，武道盛行，释教传承少之又少，段枭一介水寇竟能学到释教武技…’
‘是那血头陀刻意传授给他的！’
‘就算非是刻意，也定是在那命妙法的操控下，授给他的…’
‘命妙法…听着就与命神通相似！’
‘果然，从头到尾都是安排好的局！’
‘段枭与白家勾结掳童男童女，炼制人丹、为祸一方，本就是戏台子上的丑角，注定会和嫉恶如仇的命数之子产生碰撞…’
‘所以，当萧武对沉剑坞动手的那一刻起，血头陀便顺理成章地沾染上了命数！’
‘届时，降龙寺再派守冲前来，明面上打着捉拿‘罪僧’的旗号，实则顺水推舟，伺机渡走萧武…’
‘退一步讲，即便渡化萧武不成，也能捡回一个沾了命数的血头陀，稳赚不赔！’
沈修寒吐了口气，眼底精光闪烁，将每处关节都想通了：
‘降龙寺…守卑，早在多年前便落子布局，每一步环环相扣，此人手段之深远，心思之缜密，着实惊人！’
沈修寒情绪翻涌了一阵逐渐平息，将情报内容都记在心中，往后续情报看去。
【情报4：萧武曾在屠灭白氏满门前，独留王麟相商，言及灭白家后，欲借王麟在龙骧军中的关系暂避风头。如今，萧武、萧文、宋画堂三人皆已入龙骧军历练。】
【萧武修为臻至暗劲圆满，叩开化劲只在一念之间，然其命数屡屡示警：化劲开，身魂亡。故而压制修为，始终不叩化劲关！】
‘萧武…去了龙骧军！？’
沈修寒目光惊异，心中逐渐明白：
‘难怪长云一别之后，连『四海连心碟』上头都寻不到萧武的踪迹，原来竟是跑到了边关去。’
可这念头一转，他眉头便皱了起来：
‘不过，此举岂不是自投罗网？’
‘那镇东将军王志蕃，连同整个王家，对钓海福地与命数子的图谋昭然若揭。’
‘萧武进龙骧军，等于将自己送到王志蕃的眼皮子底下…’
‘命数示警萧武不能突破化劲…那么叩开化劲后，会发生什么事？’
沈修寒只觉一股莫名的寒意，隐隐萦绕在心头，挥之不去。
‘罢了…无论如何，福地开启之日，定能见到萧武，届时寻机会将诸事一并告知他即可…’
苍梧六魔-5＝苍梧一魔第三日。
content_en:
[Note: "Shou Bei", the abbot of Jianglong Temple in Yan State, calculated the "Blessed Land of Diaohai" by using the magical "Xintuo Edict" in his early years! 】
[Deduction and manifestation, it turns out that the blessed land-derived life number son 'Xiao Wu' is bold, open-minded, strong and decisive in nature, and his destiny and character coincide with the interpretation of the Dragon Dragon Temple. 】
[Shou Bei then used the magical method of life to control the "Sin Monk Xue Toutuo" from the lower temple of Jianglong Temple to go to Qi State and lurk in Shenjianwu of Yunshui Lake to contaminate his fate! 】
[At this time, he is using his magic method to cover up the heavenly secret, secretly ordering 'Shou Chong' to go south to Qi. The name is to capture the 'Sinful Monk Xue Toutuo', but in fact he wants to wait for an opportunity to convert Xiao Wu, and wants to abduct him back to Yan, cut off his hair and repair it! 】
Bloody Tutuo!
Shen Xiuhan's pupils tightened, his heart was filled with fear, and his eyes were full of disbelief:
‘The second master of Shenjianwu is actually a trap laid out by Yan Kingdom Jianglong Temple many years ago...’
‘They calculated the opening date of the ‘Sea Fishing Blessed Land’ early and specially sent people to hibernate around Yunshui Lake…’
'But the question is, why are they so sure that Xue Tutuo will be infected with fate? ’
Shen Xiuhan frowned and thought hard. Suddenly, a bright light filled his mind, making his pupils grow instantly:
‘Remembered! ’
'That night, when Duan Xiao was fighting with his master in Changyun County, he used a rare Taoist martial arts technique...'
‘That boxing technique… seems to be called ‘Thousand-hand Dragon Subduing Fist’? ! ’
‘Thousand-hand Dragon-Subduing Fist…Subduing Dragon Temple…’
Shen Xiuhan's heart was beating wildly, and he suddenly realized and thought to himself:
'Martial arts are prevalent in Daqi, but Buddhist inheritance is very rare. Duan Xiao and a water bandit can actually learn Buddhist martial arts...'
‘The Xue Tu Tuo deliberately taught it to him! ’
'Even if it wasn't intentional, it must have been given to him under the control of that magical law of destiny...'
‘The magical method of life…sounds similar to the magical power of life! ’
‘Sure enough, it was a well-arranged game from beginning to end! ’
'Duan Xiao colluded with the Bai family to kidnap boys and girls, refine human elixirs, and bring disaster to one side. He is a clown on the stage. He is destined to collide with the son of destiny who hates evil...'
‘So, from the moment Xiao Wu took action against Shen Jianwu, Xuetou Tuo was naturally affected by his fate! ’
'At that time, Jianglong Temple will send guards to come again. On the surface, they are arresting the 'criminal monk', but in fact they are following the current and waiting for an opportunity to cross Xiao Wu...'
'Taking a step back, even if you fail to convert Xiao Wu, you can still pick up a blood-toutuo stained with fate, and you will definitely make a profit! ’
"Huh..."
Shen Xiuhan breathed out, his eyes flashed, and he thought about every joint:
‘Jianlong Temple…Shou Bei had already laid out his plan many years ago, and every step is closely linked to each other. This person’s far-reaching means and meticulous thinking are really astonishing! ’
Shen Xiuhan's emotions surged for a while and gradually subsided. He remembered the information content in his heart and looked at the follow-up information.
[Information 4: Xiao Wu once left Wang Lin alone to discuss with him before annihilating the whole Bai family. He said that after the Bai family was destroyed, he wanted to use Wang Lin's relationship in the Longxiang army to temporarily avoid the limelight. Now, Xiao Wu, Xiao Wen, and Song Huatang have all joined the Longxiang Army for training. 】
[Xiao Wu's cultivation has reached the perfection of dark energy, and it only takes a thought to activate the energy. However, his fate repeatedly warns: when the energy is activated, the body and soul will die. Therefore, suppress your cultivation and never knock on your strength! 】
‘Xiao Wu…went to Longxiang Army! ? ’
Shen Xiuhan's eyes were surprised, and he gradually understood in his heart:
'No wonder after Changyun said goodbye, there was no trace of Xiao Wu even on the "Four Seas Connected Heart Disk". It turned out that he had gone to the border. ’
But as soon as this thought came to his mind, he frowned:
'However, wouldn't this act be a trap for oneself? ’
"The Zhendong general Wang Zhifan, together with the entire Wang family, has clearly exposed Diaohai Fudi and Fate's son's plot. ’
'Xiao Wu's entry into the Longxiang Army is tantamount to putting himself under Wang Zhifan's nose...'
‘Destiny warned Xiao Wu that he could not break through the Hua Jin... So what will happen after he opens the Hua Jin? ’
Shen Xiuhan felt an inexplicable chill lingering in his heart, lingering.
'That's all... No matter what, I will definitely be able to see Xiao Wu when the blessed land opens. I will just look for an opportunity to tell him everything...'
Cangwu Six Demons-5 = Cangwu One Demon on the third day.
